# Manning Publications

> > Manning Publications is a leading technical publisher offering books, MEAP (Manning Early Access Program), liveProjects, and liveVideos covering software development, data science, cloud infrastructure, and emerging technologies.

Manning specializes in technical content across Python, Java, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, Spark, AWS, and machine learning. The publisher features expert authors from companies like Microsoft, AWS, VMware, Red Hat, and Stripe, delivering practical learning resources for software engineers and data professionals.

## Key Topics

- MEAP (Manning Early Access Program)
- liveProjects
- Python programming
- Java development
- Kubernetes and container orchestration
- Apache Kafka streaming
- Machine learning and AI
- Big data processing (Hadoop, Spark, MapReduce)
- Cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure)
- JavaScript and web development
- DevOps and GitOps
- Data science and analytics
- Microservices architecture
- Deep learning and reinforcement learning
- Recommender systems

## Core Pages

- [Manning](https://www.manning.com): Technical publisher homepage featuring MEAP, liveProject, and liveVideos
- [Manning authors](https://www.manning.com/authors): Directory of Manning technical authors and book contributors

## Machine Learning and AI Authors

- [Ajay Thampi - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/ajay-thampi): Microsoft ML engineer specializing in interpretable and responsible AI
- [Alexander Zai - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/alexander-zai): Deep reinforcement learning and PyTorch author from Codesmith
- [Alejandro Bellogin - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/alejandro-bellogin): Recommender systems and collaborative filtering liveProjects author
- [Amit Bahree - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/amit-bahree): Microsoft Azure AI expert and Generative AI in Action author
- [Alexander Jung - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/alexander-jung): Aalto University professor specializing in federated learning
- [Alex Gascon - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/alex-gascon): Stripe backend engineer specializing in ML microservices deployment

## Cloud, DevOps, and Kubernetes Authors

- [Alex Matyushentsev - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/alex-matyushentsev): Intuit engineer and GitOps with Kubernetes and Argo author
- [Alexander Kropp - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/alexander-kropp): Apache Kafka and Kubernetes cloud computing expert
- [Alexey Nesterov - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/alexey-nesterov): VMware engineer and Spring Boot ecommerce liveProject author
- [Alexandros Koufoudakis - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/alexandros-koufoudakis): Red Hat engineer specializing in Apache Camel integration framework

## Big Data and Distributed Systems Authors

- [Amandeep Khurana - Manning author](https://www.manning.com/authors/amandeep-khurana): Cloudera solutions architect and HBase in Action author
